CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  September 13, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai
  (arrived 7:35p)
  Absent:  None
  Staff Present:  Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

ITEM 1: DRB MINUTES - August 23, 2022

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve the Minutes.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the Consent Agenda as submitted.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Tsai

DISCUSSION ITEMS:
ITEM 2: 1427 West Valley Blvd.

This application is for exterior alterations to an existing commercial building.

Applicant: Henry Ho, SLS Design, Inc.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

  1
 Hernandez, Daninger and Udani stated that they had no comments for this project.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application as submitted.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger
  Noes;  None
  Absent: Tsai

ITEM 3: 314 South 8th Street
This application is for one-story addition to an existing single-family residence.

Applicant: Ke Jiang, Want Construction

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Hernandez had no comments but complimented the applicant for working with staff and improving
the project.

Daninger pointed out typos on sheet A5 (pdf page 22) where the title should be corrected to
“Proposed”.

Udani stated that the project is improved and acceptable.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the project with the condition that the titles on sheet A5 shall
  be corrected.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Tsai

ITEM 4: 1149 South Almansor Street
This application is for a new two-story residence single- family residence.

Applicant: Steve Sun

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for continuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.
  2
 The applicant showed a revised elevation.

Udani stated that the west elevation is blank and would like to see some articulation to that elevation.
Also, on the south elevation the sills should align.

Tsai stated that the proportions on the front elevation should be reconsidered especially regarding
the pop out massing on the second floor and the layout of the two windows. Also, the proportions
are off with regard to the thin columnar elements of the porch. Also, the repetitive windows do not
seem appropriate. The identical pattern from one floor to the other does not help the building
massing as the mass is too boxy. The two windows on the second-floor windows on the front
elevation could also be improved.

Hernandez concurred with the other comments. The porch needs better Spanish detailing and
articulation. Consideration of the vertical proportions should be studied as it implies a lack of
structural integrity. The details to the porch should also carry to the porch on the south elevation.

Daninger stated that he concurs with the other comments and encouraged redesign.

Udani confirmed that the window specifications will be different and that new window information
should be provided. Also, color variation for the building should be considered.

Tsai confirmed that the rendered images do not imply a different glass.

Udani questioned the difference between scale of the exposed rafter tails. He stated further that he
would like to see the project again.

Abe summarized the design comments.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to continue the application.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

ITEM 5: 513 South Hidalgo Avenue
This application is for a one-story addition to an existing single-family residence.

Applicant: Peijie Yu

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

  3
 ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

The applicant questioned what the report meant by lack of craftsman detailing.

Abe restated that the design of the entry porch had no basis in craftsman architecture. From the
proportions of the columns, the thin proportion of the columns, the proportion of the negative space
above the doors and windows etc. None of the proposed design uses a vocabulary in the craftsman
architectural style.

Daninger stated that the two window openings replaced four openings. Also, stucco is replacing
wood siding and the porch is not in a style consistent with the home.

Tsai questioned the reuse of the chimney as the drawings do not document the chimney on the front
elevation. Also, although there are new columns at the front elevation, there are no columns shown
on the side elevation. In other words, the drawings are inaccurate and missing primary elements.
There was some confusion by the applicant but it was later clarified that Tsai was highlighting a
drawing inaccuracy.

Tsai continued that the proposed design is not a craftsman style. The materials (i.e. stucco), the
arched shapes and the front elevation in general are not craftsman in their design.

Udani stated that removal of the siding for stucco is not typical for craftsman homes and should be
reconsidered. He concurred that the front elevation is not stylistically craftsman. He highlighted the
window on the front elevation on the corner is not typically craftsman.

Hernandez concurred with all the Board comments and agreed that this is not an adequate remodel
for a craftsman home including inconsistencies that include: stucco, porch design, windows, trim,
etc. She moved for continuance.

The applicant asked if he kept the siding would it be considered craftsman?

The board was in concurrence stating that simply using wood siding does not constitute craftsman
design. But consideration of siding is a good start.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to continue the application.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

ADJOURNMENT:
There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:15 P.M. to the next meeting on
September 27, 2022.
  4
 MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:15
 •  Seconded by Daninger
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai
  Noes:  None
  Absent: None

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 27th day of September, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
